variables.name: ADMIN_PASSWORD
variables.description: REQUIRED. Admin password for RCON and REST API access. Auto-generated per deployment — copy the generated value from the service's Variables tab after deploy. Change it to your own to keep access stable across redeploys.

variables.name: PLAYERS
variables.description: Maximum number of players allowed to connect simultaneously (1-32). Each player slot consumes additional memory — 4GB RAM recommended for 16+ players.

variables.name: SERVER_NAME
variables.description: Name shown in the Palworld server browser. Leave as-is for default or customize to help friends find your server.

variables.name: SERVER_PASSWORD
variables.description: Optional password required to join the server. Leave empty for a public server, or set a password for private access.

variables.name: COMMUNITY
variables.description: Show this server in the public server browser. Set to false to hide from listings (players can still connect via IP).

variables.name: PUBLIC_IP
variables.description: Public IP address. Leave empty for auto-detection.

variables.name: PUBLIC_PORT
variables.description: Public port. Leave empty to use the default game port.

variables.name: RCON_ENABLED
variables.description: Enable remote console (RCON) access. Required for programmatic server management and player moderation tools.

variables.name: BACKUP_ENABLED
variables.description: Enable automated world backups to the persistent volume. Backups run on a daily schedule by default.

variables.name: DELETE_OLD_BACKUPS
variables.description: Automatically delete backups older than OLD_BACKUP_DAYS. Enable to prevent unlimited disk usage on the volume.

variables.name: OLD_BACKUP_DAYS
variables.description: Number of days to keep backups before deletion (only applies when DELETE_OLD_BACKUPS=true).
